events.description: Large-scale violent unrest with dense crowds of protesters and riot police in confrontation; heavy smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) deployed, fire visible in background at start, and sustained chaotic movement indicating active clashes.

A bright, sudden flash and expanding fireball visible above the street at t=0.0, consistent with an explosion (e.g., Molotov cocktail detonation or pyrotechnic device), followed by rapid smoke expansion in f1.

Large crowd of protesters and heavily equipped riot police engaged in sustained confrontation on a street at night, with dense smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) deployed across the scene, obscuring visibility and causing dispersal movements; multiple frames show officers advancing and individuals retreating or moving erratically amid the haze.

Large crowd of protesters and riot police engaged in violent confrontation on a street at night; thick smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) fills the air, individuals are seen running, throwing objects, and clashing; multiple frames show projectiles mid-air and chaotic movement consistent with active rioting.

In frames f5–f7, close-up clusters of individuals are seen grappling and striking each other amid the smoke; at least two distinct pairs appear engaged in mutual physical combat, with one person being pushed to the ground in f6.

A sudden bright white flash and expanding smoke plume originate from near the center-left of the road in frame f12, consistent with a small explosive device (e.g., stun grenade or smoke canister detonation); the effect is transient and localized, not sustained fire.

Large crowd engaged in violent unrest on a street at night, with dense smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) filling the area, people running and scattering, some holding shields, and visible chaotic movement consistent with a riot or confrontation between protesters and security forces.

Large crowd engaged in violent unrest on a street at night, with visible smoke/tear gas, debris, and individuals moving aggressively; some appear to be throwing objects or advancing toward a line of figures in dark gear (likely law enforcement) on the right side of the frame.

Large crowd engaged in violent unrest with police line; visible smoke/tear gas, projectiles being thrown, and chaotic movement across the street; individuals in riot gear and civilians clashing or retreating under haze.
Large crowd engaged in violent unrest, with individuals throwing objects and moving aggressively toward a line of uniformed personnel; smoke and debris visible across the scene.
Scene shifts to aftermath: fire burning near trees, heavy smoke, scattered debris, and remaining groups of people moving erratically; no active large-scale confrontation but continued unrest evident.
